summary: Frontend regression + new-feature coverage pass for the Track Artist/Title auto-read, Missing-file badge, Batch Export, and Voice-recorder rename features. License Q61VK-G819N-40K1B-H226T activated fresh, legal terms accepted, studio reached. Playlist created and 3 files uploaded via [data-testid=add-files-input] set_input_files: (row 0) tagged.mp3 -> name='One More Time', artist='Daft Punk', file='MP3 · tagged.mp3' (ID3 read OK); (row 1) 'Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up.mp3' -> name='Never Gonna Give You Up', artist='Rick Astley', file='MP3 · Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up.mp3' (filename fallback OK); (row 2) hltest.wav -> name='hltest', artist='Unknown artist', file='WAV · hltest.wav' (default fallback OK). Inline edit on row 2: edit-info-2 -> title-input-2='Custom Title 2' / artist-input-2='Custom Artist 2' -> save-info-2 -> confirmed track-name-2 and track-artist-2 updated AND persisted after a full page reload (localStorage-backed state). Header track-search-input 'daft' correctly filters to just the Daft Punk row (other rows hidden). Batch export via batch-export-button -> batch-export-modal -> batch-run downloaded 'BX Test 2026-09-18.mp3', batch-status='Done', batch-results shows '✓ BX Test' (checkmark) with no unhandled errors. Single-playlist export via sidebar hover -> export-playlist-{id} -> export-playlist-modal -> export-run also downloaded 'BX Test 2026-09-18.mp3' successfully (modal auto-closes after download completes). Core playout regressions: play-track-1 loads hltest.wav into the player-bar (footer shows 'hltest.wav' with duration 0:01), cue-track-1 clickable, edit-track-1 opens the track-editor-modal with rendered waveform (2 canvases, 'Drag the amber handles to set start & end' visible), remove-track-1 reduced row count 2->1. Voice recorder: record-voice-button opens voice-recorder-modal (title 'Voice Track', record dot, 'Tap to record' hint) — HOWEVER the [data-testid=voice-name] File-name input + '.wav' hint is only rendered AFTER a recording has been made (status==='recorded' branch), so it is NOT visible when the modal simply opens as the review request expected. No blocking console errors or page errors beyond the pre-existing benign React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' carried over from PlayerBar dev instrumentation.

ui_bugs.issue: voice-name (File name) field + '.wav' suffix hint only render after recording (status==='recorded'). Review request said 'confirm the modal opens and the File name field is present with .wav suffix (do not need to actually record)'. Current UX hides the field until Stop is pressed. Either surface a placeholder file-name row from the moment the modal opens, or update the acceptance criteria.

issues: Pre-existing dev-only React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — non-blocking, carries over from previous iterations

action_items: VoiceRecorder: either render the voice-name input + '.wav' hint from the moment the modal opens (as the review criteria implies) or update the review checklist. Current code gates it behind status==='recorded'.
critical_code_review_comments: TrackList.js correctly wires track-name-{i}/track-artist-{i}/track-file-{i} with the greyed 'WAV/MP3 · filename' subtitle and the inline edit-info / title-input / artist-input / save-info triplet — verified end-to-end.

lib/id3.js deriveNames + parseFilename produce the correct precedence: ID3 (tagged.mp3), filename 'Artist - Title' pattern (Rick Astley file), then bare filename with 'Unknown artist' fallback (hltest.wav) — all three cases pass with real files.
lib/playlistExport.js downloadBlob + datedFilename produce 'PlaylistName YYYY-MM-DD.<ext>' — confirmed 'BX Test 2026-09-18.mp3' downloaded from both single and batch exports.

BatchExportModal batch-status/batch-results reach terminal 'Done' state with per-playlist checkmark — resilient path (skip unreadable tracks) works: batch run for a playlist that includes the synthetic tagged.mp3 completed without an unhandled exception.
State persistence: after a full page reload, custom title/artist edits on a row survive (JSON in localStorage). License activation also persists (hotlive95_license key).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all 8 review scenarios passed except the pre-recording visibility of voice-name field

test_credentials: License key Q61VK-G819N-40K1B-H226T (each fresh browser profile requires re-activation). Test audio: /tmp/tagged.mp3, /tmp/Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up.mp3, /tmp/hltest.wav.
seed_data_creation: Playlists 'Test Playlist', 'BX Test', 'R' created in localStorage during test — no server-side persistence involved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Every browser session starts on a fresh profile so you must activate Q61VK-G819N-40K1B-H226T and accept legal terms each run. [data-testid=add-files-input] is hidden by design — use page.set_input_files() directly, do NOT wait_for_selector visible. tagged.mp3 is a synthetic file: ID3 header valid but no decodable audio, so its duration is '--:--' and it is expected to be SKIPPED during export (skipped counter increments) — not a bug. TrackEditor modal has no Escape-to-close binding, use the [aria-label] X button in the header if you need to programmatically close it. Voice-name input only exists once a recording is made; test env has no mic so you cannot exercise it in headless.
rca of the issue: VoiceRecorder gates the File-name/.wav row behind {status === 'recorded'} (VoiceRecorder.js lines 141-160). Since the review request's acceptance criterion is 'File name field present with .wav suffix hint on modal open (no need to record)', either (a) move the file-name input outside the {status==='recorded'} conditional so it renders in idle/recording states too (with a default 'Voice YYYY-MM-DD HH-MM' name), or (b) accept that the field materialises only post-recording and adjust the review checklist. Recommend (a) so DJs can pre-name a take before hitting record — matches the described UX in the session summary ('Voice recorder file-name rename field').
